candidates.claim: The delta rewrites the Port error tables to say the message ends in `{Neutron message}`, but the shared ErrorHandler appends the HTTP `statusText` (or "Unknown error"), not the Neutron response body message. The docs therefore describe behaviour the code does not have.
candidates.location: packages/aurora/docs/0017_ports_bff.md | | 400         | `BAD_REQUEST`           | Invalid request data for Port: {Neutron message} |
candidates.evidence: errorHandling.ts at 86a355a8: `message: `Unauthorized access to ${resourceLabel}: ${response.statusText || "Unknown error"}``, same for 400/403/default (Failed to process). errorHandling.ts is not changed in the PR, and requestOrThrow passes the response to the handler, so no Neutron body message is used. delta.diff lines 41-142 add `{Neutron message}` to the 401/403/default/412 rows.
candidates.precedent: The pre-existing 400 rows for create/update already said {Neutron message}, so the doc inaccuracy was present before and this delta extends it to more rows.
